name: patroltech
description: Security patrol management: check missed rounds, suspicious scans, incidents and access logs, and set up checkpoints and routes in PatrolTech. Every change waits for your confirmation.

interface.longDescription:
PatrolTech is a work tool for managing security guard patrols. Connect your PatrolTech account and ask in plain language about your patrol data: rounds, checkpoint scans, incidents and access logs.

See what really happened on site:
- Which rounds were missed last night, route by route, with every checkpoint scanned or skipped.
- Suspicious scans flagged for GPS distance, timing or invalid tags, per guard, checkpoint or site.
- Checkpoints nobody has scanned for days.
- Who is inside a building right now, from visitor and access logs.
- Open incidents with status, priority, photos and comments.

Change things safely: create checkpoints, build routes with schedules, add time windows, switch routes on or off, rename guards, edit sites and update incidents. PatrolTech only proposes each change; nothing is applied until you confirm. Deleting data, inviting users and creating guard credentials are never available to the assistant.

Works across several organizations and sites, respects each user's role, answers in your language and local time. OAuth sign-in with your PatrolTech account, rate limits and an audit log of every tool call.

Built for private security companies, facility and property managers, corporate security teams, industrial sites, hospitals, retail and residential communities. Requires a PatrolTech account.
capabilities: Check which patrol rounds were completed, incomplete or missed
Find suspicious or invalid checkpoint scans by guard, checkpoint or site
List checkpoints that have not been scanned for days
Review security incidents and update their status, comments and assignee
See visitor and access logs and who is inside a site now
Propose checkpoints, routes and schedules, applied only after you confirm
Get a printable QR sheet for checkpoints
